batches.objective: Establish explicit attachment compatibility admission along ordinary native Vulkan render-pass execution.
batches.rationale: The completed typed draw-recording batch exposed backend attachment adoption of caller extent/format and resource sample count. Upstream admission must be traced before declaring a reproduced defect or adding duplicate checks.
batches.nextAction: Trace public render-pass descriptors and view identity through native admission, queue snapshots and ensure_render_target; identify the existing authority for format, extent and sample compatibility.
acceptance: Exercise public compatible and incompatible attachments, independent pixel checks, rejection without invalid submission and a subsequent valid operation.
Preserve caller resource leases and completion-aware cleanup; retain focused failure and cost observations.
Record the actual consumer and observable consequence; leave surface synchronization and other backends separate.
batches.stopCondition: Stop after one complete attachment-admission boundary and its evidence. Query ordering, bundle rejection, SPIR-V ownership, typed recording and the build recipe remain closed.
requiredEnvironment: Linux Vulkan for ordinary public rendering; validation-layer coverage where installed.
